public_boundary: src/runtime-client.mjs: module function runTry({words, options, cwd}, ports)
runtime_reason: The owning prompt has no Runtime interface. Native Git repository lookup and private saved-state reads/writes are unbound. This inventory is not a prompt-runtime.program-scenario.v1 scenario. No check-only API is proposed.
native_replay: NOT RUN; replay must exercise the real public boundary with isolated Git/state and deterministic injected transport

criteria.text: After I start a simulation with `pdd simulate user_stories/rehearsal/control-panel.md`, `pdd simulate --stop user_stories/rehearsal/control-panel.md` stops that saved simulation, prints `The Try link for "Control panel rehearsal" is stopped.`, and exits 0.
For the same saved simulation, `pdd simulate --stop control-panel` also stops it, prints the same confirmation, and exits 0.

The saved test path `tests/rehearsal/control-panel.json` and test name `control-panel` still identify the simulation. A stop also works on a branch where the original Story file is absent. With one saved simulation, `pdd simulate --stop` still stops it.

A stop removes only the selected saved simulation after the service confirms the stop. A DELETE response of 404 or 410 also counts as confirmation. An unconfirmed stop keeps the saved record and returns a nonzero exit. An unknown or ambiguous selector stops nothing and exits 2.

setup.isolation: Each case gets a fresh temporary Git repository and external private state directory. No recovered project inputs, credentials or live sessions.

ports.fetch: Deterministic DELETE and GET replies; collect methods, paths and request IDs. No hosted requests.
ports.gh: Fixed synthetic token and account replies, held in memory only.
ports.now_sleep_randomUUID: Fixed clock, immediate deterministic waits and distinct fixed UUIDs.
ports.stdout_stderr: Captured streams; each emitted line ends with a newline.
ports.native_effects: Real temporary Git root lookup and private state reads/writes. These effects are not interpreter bindings.

setup.default_stop_reply: DELETE accepts a stop job; GET confirms that job passed
setup.expected_stdout: The Try link for "Control panel rehearsal" is stopped.

cases.given: Current branch has no original Story or test file; saved record remains
DELETE accepts a stop job; its terminal result does not confirm success
Two distinct saved records have the same short Story name
